subject: sets/cdo/cdo-align
verdict: Ships clean at draft time, but the Mock contract is not truthful across the card lifecycle — every confirmed card carries a dead mock path that resolve-item surfaces into Dev Notes, and the standard's multi-file mock is unfileable.
summary: The extension's design rules are its strength: the browser-chrome/layer-delta wire convention and the token-grounded mock contract are non-inferable, earn their place, and are wired deterministically at filing. The opportunity is lifecycle truthfulness: apply-decisions moves the mock file on every hop but never rewrites the Mock line that cites it, and nothing downstream existence-checks the claimed path — so the artifact furthest downstream (Dev Notes) deterministically embeds a dead link.

themes.title: Mock pointer goes stale on every lifecycle move
themes.root_cause: file-cards.py owns the Mock line at draft time but apply-decisions.py's move_assets relocates the file on archive/defer/resurface/unpark while the card body is written verbatim — the citing line is never rewritten. resolve-item then trusts the stale literal as status `path` with no existence check, and pipeline.md embeds it into Dev Notes. The confirm-edited strip clause inherits the same asymmetry.
themes.action: Pick one fix point: either apply-decisions rewrites `**Mock:**` to the moved destination at every hop (same _set_mock_line surgery file-cards uses), or resolve-item resolves the mock path card-relative instead of trusting the literal. Also: line-scope the wireframe status parse, align Mock regex anchoring writer/reader, warn on move_assets dest.exists(), and clarify the confirm-edited strip clause covers both artifacts.

themes.title: file-cards.py mock staging has contract and edge gaps
themes.root_cause: The staging contract enforces one file renamed to mock.html while the standard advertises a multi-file mock/ dir; several edge inputs (directory path, same-src-as-dest, missing Visual Preview, terminal Wireframe line, cwd-relative source) degrade silently or crash mid-drain, and the placeholder-styling flag is prose-only.
themes.action: Decide the contract — implement directory staging (copytree under assets/{key}/mock/) or restrict design-mock.md/template to single-file. Then guard the edges: skip copy when src==dest, anchor relative paths to the --cards file's parent, warn/flag when no Visual Preview section exists, guard the index() append, and auto-flag ungrounded:design-tokens when the staged header says placeholder styling.

themes.title: Duplicated contract constants across producer and consumer
themes.root_cause: The assets path literal `alignment/drafts/assets/{key}/` is copy-pasted across file-cards.py, five apply-decisions.py sites, and four docs, and the n/a|unavailable|absent status vocab lives in five surfaces — already drifted ('mock not produced' vs 'mock file missing'). cardlayout.py exists to be the ONE layout definition but was never extended; file-cards' parked-supersede branch implements the same hop differently than apply-decisions.
themes.action: Extend cardlayout.py with the assets taxonomy (MOCK_FILENAME, mock_assets_dir(), superseded_assets(), MOCK_STATUS/WIRE_STATUS enums, shared _section parser) and vendor to both skills; replace literals; make resolve-item's parser enumerate known statuses and emit 'unknown' instead of failing open to 'path'; pick one unavailable string; move parked/assets/{key}/ in file-cards' supersede branch.

themes.title: The mock ships without a verification floor
themes.root_cause: The spec claimed taste-skill's verification discipline was borrowed but only its sensibility arrived: the wire has schema validation + a liveness gate, while the mock's entire check is is_file() — empty files, non-HTML blobs, or CDN-linked files stage silently and earn checklist credibility.
themes.action: Two cheap pieces: a pre-filing self-check line in design-mock.md's card contract, and a minimal mechanical check in _mock_plan warning on empty/tiny files, missing HTML structure, or external http(s) asset refs — warning posture, never blocking. resolve-item gates `path` on existence + .html suffix as defense-in-depth.

themes.title: Prompt-layer polish: restated rules, dead pointers, unrouted dirs
themes.root_cause: SKILL.md's Visual Preview bullet re-teaches the wire standard it routes to (third copy across files); design-mock.md carries skill-name attributions readers can't act on; wireframe.md numbers non-sequential constraints; the template ships dead ./references/ pointers into every filed card; specs/ is an unrouted one-off dir; SKILL.md is 400+ tokens over budget and lacks a Resolution rules block.
themes.action: Compress the SKILL.md bullet to outcome + payload contract (proposed_smallest provided); drop skill attributions keeping distilled rules; demote wireframe rules 3-5 to bullets; qualify the template's standards pointer; move or delete specs/; stamp a Resolution rules block and normalize new references to bare paths in one sweep of the cdo set.

strengths: The two-artifact convention is non-inferable and earns its place — browser-chrome framing, current/proposed layer split, and token-grounding would not emerge from a bare model or the wiretext tool description.

file-cards.py's deterministic Mock-line ownership at draft time ('the script owns this line so the staged path is always truthful') is the right pattern — the defect is that it stops at the first hop.
Degrade-don't-fail posture preserved end-to-end: missing wiretext/mock never blocks filing, matching the existing unavailable convention.
ungrounded:design-tokens correctly reuses the established ungrounded:{store} flag convention.
move_assets already relocates the whole assets/{key}/ dir — the lifecycle plumbing is multi-file-ready even though staging isn't.
All 58 modified-suite tests pass; file-cards.py and preflight.py are clean under script-standards lint.

recommendations.action: Make the Mock line truthful across moves: rewrite it in apply-decisions at each hop (or resolve card-relative in resolve-item — pick one), existence-check the path in resolve-item, and line-scope the wireframe status parse.
Extend cardlayout.py with the assets taxonomy + status enums + shared section parser; vendor to both skills and replace all literals.

Close staging edges in file-cards.py: decide dir-vs-single-file contract, guard SameFileError, anchor relative paths to the cards file's parent, warn on missing Visual Preview, guard the terminal-line index().
Add the mock verification floor: mechanical content check in _mock_plan + self-check line in design-mock.md + ungrounded:design-tokens auto-flag.
Leanness sweep: compress SKILL.md bullet to proposed_smallest, drop skill attributions, fix wireframe.md numbering, relocate specs/, qualify template pointers.
One cdo-set sweep: stamp Resolution rules blocks and normalize ./ paths to bare convention (org-wide gap, not just this change).

journeys.name: Draft → file
journeys.steps: grounded read → wiretext wire + HTML mock → cards.json with mock → file-cards stages and stamps Mock line → checklist carries | mock: — smooth and deterministic

journeys.name: Confirm → consume
journeys.steps: apply-decisions archives card + moves assets — but Mock line stays drafts-rooted → resolve-item reports stale path → pipeline embeds dead link in Dev Notes

journeys.name: Defer → resurface
journeys.steps: parked card's assets move to parked/assets/; on resurface they return — Mock line still cites drafts/ the whole time

experience.headless: file-cards.py and apply-decisions.py are fully scriptable; the mock staging path works headless, but the dead-link defect is invisible headless too — nothing validates the cited path at consume time.

findings.title: 8 cross-dir ./ path references — legacy convention extended by new lines
findings.evidence: Path-standards scan found 8 `cross-dir-dot-slash` findings. Most are pre-existing convention (`./scripts/preflight.py`, `./references/grounding.md`), but the new Visual Preview bullet and template comment added more instances under the same style instead of bare skill-root paths.
findings.recommendation: Sweep the cdo set once to bare `references/foo.md` convention rather than per-file; new lines should not extend the `./` style.

findings.title: SKILL.md 3406 tokens — over 3000 budget
findings.evidence: Mostly pre-existing bulk; the new Visual Preview bullet added ~100 tokens of rule restatement the references own. Compressing it per leanness-1 claws some back.
findings.recommendation: Apply leanness-1's proposed_smallest; a deeper trim of the whole file is out of this change's scope but worth a separate pass.

findings.title: cardlayout.py: 3 agentic-design findings + missing tests (pre-existing)
findings.evidence: Unrelated to this change but relevant to customization-1: the module that should own the assets taxonomy is itself flagged (agentic-design x3, no tests).
findings.recommendation: When extending cardlayout.py for the assets contract, address the lint findings and add tests.

findings.title: SKILL.md Visual Preview bullet restates the wire standard it routes to
findings.evidence: The bullet carries the wire's four signature conventions inline — browser chrome, multi-frame single wire, layerId split, to-be drawn in place — then routes to wireframe.md which states them verbatim. A third restatement sits in the template comment. Three copies of one rule set is three drift surfaces in a file already over budget.
findings.recommendation: Compress the wire half of the bullet to outcome + routing + the payload contract.
findings.proposed_smallest: **Visual preview (UI-touching items)** — produce both design artifacts from the same grounded read: the wire per `./references/wireframe.md` (embed the URL in the card and pass it as `wireframe` in the filing JSON — a confirmed card's URL satisfies the pipeline's wireframe gate) and one self-contained HTML mock on the project's real design tokens per `./references/design-mock.md` (pass the produced file as `mock`; the script stages it at `alignment/drafts/assets/{key}/mock.html`). `n/a — no UI surface` on both for non-UI items; `unavailable — {reason}` when a tool genuinely fails — optional artifacts never block filing, and a missing wiretext does not excuse a missing mock.
findings.predicted_delta: The wire's framing conventions leave the entry file, so a run that skips loading wireframe.md produces an unframed sketch — but the routing line makes skipping non-compliant behavior the reference-load convention already guards. Expect no loss on compliant runs; route to variant eval to confirm.

findings.title: design-mock.md carries provenance attributions to external skills the reader may not hold
findings.evidence: 'Borrow taste-skill's sensibility' and 'follow the emil-design-eng rubric selectively' name skills a reader may not have installed; the distilled rules that follow already carry every actionable instruction. The specs/ file records the sourcing for maintainers.
findings.recommendation: Drop the skill-name attributions and keep the distilled rules and guardrails.

findings.title: wireframe.md 'Build it grounded' numbers a list whose last three items are not a sequence
findings.evidence: Steps 1-2 are a true sequence; steps 3-5 (annotate placement-only, type components, copy-true) are concurrent constraints on the same drawing act, not ordered steps.
findings.recommendation: Keep 1-2 as the ordered opening, demote 3-5 to unnumbered rules.

findings.title: 'Commentary, not design' motif and wiretext-doesn't-excuse-mock rule each restated 3+ times
findings.evidence: The 'sketch is commentary' framing appears in wireframe.md twice and again in grounding.md and the template; 'missing wiretext does not excuse missing mock' is stated three times. Per-file repetition is defensible motif reinforcement but wireframe.md states its own thesis twice.
findings.recommendation: Keep line-15's concrete formulation in wireframe.md, compress line 3's; if leanness-1 lands, shrink the template comment's wire sentence.

findings.title: Mock pointer goes stale on every lifecycle move — dead path reaches pipeline Dev Notes
findings.evidence: apply-decisions moves assets/{key}/ on defer/confirm/reject/resurface/unpark but the card body is written verbatim — the Mock line still cites alignment/drafts/. resolve-item parses the stale line as status 'path' and pipeline.md embeds it in Dev Notes — a dead link on every confirmed UI-touching card.
findings.recommendation: Single fix point: rewrite the Mock line at each move, or resolve the path card-relative in resolve-item. Do one, not both.

findings.title: Multi-file mock contract in design-mock.md has no staging path
findings.evidence: design-mock.md offers 'one file per surface under the same mock dir' but _mock_plan requires is_file() and _copy_mock renames to mock.html — a drafter following the multi-file option gets one file staged under the wrong name, siblings dropped, Mock line rewritten.
findings.recommendation: Tighten design-mock.md to the single-file contract, or extend the payload to accept a directory and stage all files under assets/{key}/.

findings.title: file-cards.py parked-supersede branch orphans parked mock assets
findings.evidence: The manual-marker-flip route moves parked/{key}.md → superseded/ but never moves parked/assets/{key}/; apply-decisions performs the identical hop and does move assets. The stale parked dir can also block a future defer's move via move_assets' silent dest.exists() early-return.
findings.recommendation: Move parked/assets/{key}/ → superseded/{key}.{stamp}.parked.assets/ in the parked-supersede branch; add a test.

findings.title: Multi-file SKILL.md has no Resolution rules block
findings.evidence: SKILL.md references ~7 internal files across three dirs with ./-prefixed paths but no Resolution rules block — an org-wide gap the new line extended.
findings.recommendation: Stamp the canonical Resolution rules block; normalize new references to bare paths; sweep the cdo set once.

findings.title: cdo-review confirm-edited 'strip' leaves stale mock handling ambiguous
findings.evidence: The offer says 'same call covers both' but defines strip as removing the wire URL while the mock 'degrades to unavailable on the next re-draft' — read literally the stale mock stays on the signed card and flows to Dev Notes.
findings.recommendation: State explicitly that strip applies to both artifacts (set Mock to unavailable — design superseded by edit, or delete the line).

findings.title: specs/ is a one-off unrouted directory
findings.evidence: Only specs/ dir across the ~20-skill cdo set; nothing routes to it; it's an implementation record, not runtime content.
findings.recommendation: Adopt specs/ as an org convention or relocate the record out of the skill.

findings.title: Template comment bakes skill-relative standards paths into every filed card
findings.evidence: 'Standards: ./references/wireframe.md and ./references/design-mock.md' persists verbatim into every filed card where the path resolves to nothing — a dead pointer shipped inside the artifact; the change doubled the dead surface.
findings.recommendation: Qualify the pointer ('standards live in the cdo-align skill — references/…') or drop it.

findings.title: Mock line is never rewritten when assets move — every confirmed/parked/superseded card cites a dead path
findings.evidence: file-cards.py stamps a drafts-rooted Mock path; apply-decisions moves the asset dir on every hop while writing the body verbatim. resolve-item emits mock_status 'path' off the confirmed card and pipeline.md instructs embedding it in Dev Notes — a deterministically dead link. Lifecycle tests assert the move, never the citing line. move_assets also returns silently on dest.exists().
findings.recommendation: Rewrite the Mock line to the destination's orch-relative path at each hop (assets_moved is already returned); warn instead of silently returning on dest.exists(); add existence validation in resolve-item as defense-in-depth.

findings.title: mock_status 'path' trusts the line text — no existence or shape check anywhere
findings.evidence: resolve-item classifies anything not n/a/unavailable as 'path' — no .html check, no is_file(), no traversal rejection; even an unfilled placeholder parses as path. Mirror image: _mock_plan returns (None,None) when the filing JSON lacks mock but the card body claims one — the claim is never staged or checked. The wireframe field is held to a higher bar than a local file whose existence is trivially checkable.
findings.recommendation: file-cards: when mock is absent but the body claims a path, existence-check and degrade to 'unavailable — mock declared but not staged'. resolve-item: gate 'path' on (orch/mval).is_file() and .html suffix.

findings.title: Documented multi-file mock/ contract is unimplemented — directory degrades to unavailable
findings.evidence: The standard documents mock/{surface}.html multi-file output but _copy_mock stages exactly one file renamed mock.html; a directory path hits is_file() → unavailable; a single file of a set stages alone while _set_mock_line rewrites the drafter's per-surface line. Lifecycle side is already multi-file-ready; staging isn't.
findings.recommendation: Implement directory staging (copytree + preserve the drafter's Mock line) or amend the standard to single-file-only so the written contract matches the enforced one.

findings.title: Relative mock paths resolve against process CWD — undeclared anchor
findings.evidence: A relative mock path anchors to wherever uv run launched, not the cards file or orchestration dir — same payload resolves differently by launch context, or stages a same-named wrong file. Every other path the script touches anchors to --orchestration-dir.
findings.recommendation: Anchor relative paths to the --cards file's parent directory, or reject relative paths in _validate with a named error.

findings.title: Missing Visual Preview section silently desynchronizes the two mock records
findings.evidence: When mock is supplied but the body lacks ## Visual Preview, _set_mock_line returns unchanged yet the file still stages and the checklist carries | mock: — the filesystem and checklist say a mock exists while the card records nothing; resolve-item reports 'absent' against a real file, no warning.
findings.recommendation: Warn (or mark contract_broken) when mock is supplied but no Visual Preview section exists.

findings.title: Mock sentinel text cross-contaminates wireframe status; writer/reader use different line shapes
findings.evidence: wireframe_status searches the whole Visual Preview section, so a Mock line's 'n/a — no UI surface' or 'unavailable' satisfies the wireframe check on a malformed card. Separately, file-cards anchors Mock-line writes to column 0 while resolve-item matches unanchored — an indented stale line survives replace but wins first-match parse.
findings.recommendation: Line-scope the wireframe status parse to the Wireframe line; align regex anchoring between writer and reader.

findings.title: Unguarded index('\n') crashes mid-drain on a terminal Wireframe line
findings.evidence: If the Wireframe line is the body's last line with no trailing newline, index raises ValueError → exit 2 mid-batch after earlier cards already filed and flipped backlog markers — half-applied state against the 'no half-filed runs' contract.
findings.recommendation: Guard the index (m.end() < len(new_sec), else append at section end).

findings.title: Mock-assets path copy-pasted across producer and consumer scripts instead of living in cardlayout.py
findings.evidence: The staging contract literal appears in file-cards.py and at five sites in apply-decisions.py plus variants, while cardlayout.py — vendored into six skills precisely to be 'the ONE definition of where a card may live' — was never extended, and file-cards.py doesn't import it. Docs repeat the literal four more times. A future path change must be hand-synced or mocks orphan.
findings.recommendation: Extend cardlayout.py with the assets taxonomy (mock_assets_dir, MOCK_FILENAME, superseded_assets), vendor to all copies, replace the literals. Keep it a code constant — the writable root is already configurable via {orchestration_dir}.

findings.title: Visual Preview status vocab duplicated across five surfaces and already drifted; parser fails open
findings.evidence: The path|n/a|unavailable|absent vocabulary is restated in template, SKILL.md, design-mock.md, emitted by file-cards, parsed by resolve-item — no single definition. Drift exists: docs say 'unavailable — mock not produced', script emits 'unavailable — mock file missing'. resolve-item's else→'path' fallback means any future status string silently parses as a file path. Same duplication class predates the change (RISK_TOKENS, _section re-implemented twice).
findings.recommendation: Hoist the vocabulary into the shared layer: status enums, sentinel strings, shared parse helper; make unrecognized values report 'unknown' not 'path'; align the emitted string with the documented one.

findings.title: No customize.toml — correctly absent; confirm the opt-out stays deliberate
findings.evidence: No config surface warranted: writable roots flow via {orchestration_dir}, the template is a parser contract not a swappable format, annotation budgets and 160ms are illustrative standard text. No env vars or ad-hoc config introduced.
findings.recommendation: No action — record the no-customize decision in the memlog and keep it that way.

findings.title: Add: verification step for the mock — the renderable artifact nothing verifies
findings.evidence: The spec claims taste-skill's verification discipline was borrowed but only its sensibility arrived. The wire has schema validation + liveness gate; the mock's entire check is is_file() — an empty file, non-HTML blob, or HTML full of CDN links stages silently and earns checklist credibility.
findings.recommendation: Add a pre-filing self-check line to design-mock.md's card contract plus a minimal mechanical check in _mock_plan (warn on empty/tiny, missing HTML structure, external asset refs) — warning posture, never blocking.

findings.title: Add: Mock-line rewrite on lifecycle moves — confirmed cards carry a dead mock link
findings.evidence: file-cards established 'the script owns this line so the staged path is always truthful' — apply-decisions breaks that ownership on the next hop: the archived card is written verbatim while move_assets relocates the file. Every confirmed card's Mock path is a dead link that resolve-item surfaces into Dev Notes. The lifecycle test suite asserts the file moved but never the citing line.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite the Mock line to the new location before writing the moved card at every hop; add tests asserting the card's Mock line post-move.

findings.title: Add: multi-file mock staging — the standard prescribes an output the filer rejects
findings.evidence: design-mock.md sanctions one-file-per-surface but _mock_plan requires is_file() — a conformant multi-surface mock dir gets 'unavailable'. The 6 added tests cover the single-file contract only.
findings.recommendation: Extend _mock_plan to accept a directory, or remove the multi-file option from the standard. Test whichever contract wins.

findings.title: Add: wire ungrounded:design-tokens into the Flags contract — currently prose-only 'should'
findings.evidence: The placeholder-styling failure mode is defined and flags 'should carry' the token, but nothing checks the correlation — a placeholder mock can file with zero flags and land in Routine Review, the exact signal loss the flag exists to prevent. Same class as the unsigned-cosign auto-flag.
findings.recommendation: Name the token in the template's Flags enumeration and add a cross-check in _copy_mock: staged file's header says placeholder styling but flags lack the token → append it or warn.

findings.title: Add (opportunity): make the annotation budget enumerable
findings.evidence: The spec promised an 'annotation budget' but the delivered rule is qualitative only — 'annotate what and where, never why' plus the paragraph test. A budget in name only.
findings.recommendation: Add one numeric bound — e.g., 'one annotation per proposed object, ≤ ~15 words' — keeping the paragraph test as backstop.

findings.title: Add (opportunity): two mock-edge guards — same-file copy crash and orphan checklist pointer
findings.evidence: If the model stages the mock directly at the dest path and passes it, shutil.copy2 raises SameFileError → exit 2 mid-batch. If the card body lacks Visual Preview, the file stages and the checklist points at a Mock line that doesn't exist. Neither has a test.
findings.recommendation: Skip the copy when src resolves to dest; warn when no Visual Preview section exists. One test each.

findings.title: Remove: specs/ design history shipped inside the skill
findings.evidence: The skill's path conventions recognize references|assets|scripts; specs/ is a fourth directory holding the change's design doc — historical rationale no runtime step loads. Removing costs nothing at run time; the 'why' lives in git history.
findings.recommendation: Move to repo docs/module history or delete — a directory's worth of surface for zero runtime value.
